cache.production.lease-tier.bounded-plan: explicit plan starts from COMPLETE lease discovery and COMPLETE deep archive audit
only inactive owners with no unarchived live segment are considered
separate age, minimum-history, per-package, aggregate-byte, and candidate ceilings
planning creates no tier root and has no tier-write or deletion authority

cache.production.lease-tier.export-appro: proposal binds source-cache and tier-root fingerprints plus exact lease and archive snapshots
application requires explicit authority and the structurally validated proposal digest
changed source history, copied source root, overlap, or changed payload bytes fail before tier writes

cache.production.lease-tier.source-prese: export copies the exact sealed anchor and every current archive file
application receipt fixes source_files_removed at zero
source deep-audit summary is unchanged before and after export
no semantic deletion function or CLI route is exposed

cache.production.lease-tier.content-addr: package directory is named by the sealed manifest digest
manifest binds sorted relative path, byte count, and content digest descriptors
payload files are exact-written before the manifest
exact partial export is resumable and conflicting or unclassified content is never overwritten

cache.production.lease-tier.package-audi: read-only audit validates package directory shape, manifest seal, every payload byte, and snapshot digest
same-size corruption, missing payload, links, and extra content become path-private REVIEW_REQUIRED holds
audit does not claim remote durability, immutability, or authenticity

cache.production.lease-tier.restore-appr: restore requires explicit authority and exact package-digest approval
target must be absent, fresh, or contain only exact partial package paths
archive payload is written before the recovery anchor
corrupt packages, overlap, and unclassified target content fail before authoritative restore

cache.production.lease-tier.restore-equi: target full audit must reproduce the source anchor, tail, segment, event, rollup, file, byte, and storage-snapshot summary
target lease discovery must reproduce lease id, anchor digest, and history generation
fresh child process independently reopens the package and deep-audits the restored cache
proof is for the named bounded fixture and exact package only

cache.production.lease-tier.truth-bounda: local content-addressed storage is tamper-evident but external_immutability remains false
export and restore never run automatically
tier package existence grants no semantic-retention or source-deletion authority
off-device durability, receiver acceptance, scheduling, authentication, promotion, and CANON remain outside this capability
